meta.evidenceClass: static only: classification text (11 batches) + read-only git/grep spot checks; nothing compiled or run
meta.filter: windowsApplicability in {applies, applies-with-adaptation} AND windowsStatus in {partial, missing, unknown}

tierDescriptions.T0: Foundations, compliance and audit (unblock everything else; no or little direct user value)
tierDescriptions.T1: High/medium-value user-visible features and correctness fixes
tierDescriptions.T2: Medium-value polish and cheap independent fixes
tierDescriptions.T3: Low-value polish, phone-leaning or decision-gated families

meta.howToRead: slices[] are ordered; prerequisites reference earlier slice ids; entries[].primarySlice is the owning slice, secondarySlices[] are ride-along touches.
meta.generatorPolicy: Each slice = one generator (+ desktop adapter) + Python source tests; no Gradle/JVM/app (resource policy).

slices.title: Static symbol-resolution gate (Python-only cascade detector)
risks: A static import/definer scan is not a compile: typealias, extension and generated-source resolution can give false positives and negatives.
Must scan generator OUTPUT, not stale desktop/build/generated; needs an allowlist for Android SDK/AndroidX/third-party imports and Windows shims.
Compile is deferred by policy, so this gate is the only cheap way to see dependency cascades early.
slices.firstStep: Write desktop/tools/check_slice_symbol_closure.py that runs the generators into a scratch directory, collects top-level declarations of every carried slice file, desktop/src file and generator output, and fails on com.android.purebilibili imports whose definer exists nowhere. Seed the expected-miss list with: userVipPink, resolveVideoDisplayProgressState, resolveWatchLaterDisplayProgressState, resolveVideoCardStatsTexts, AppPressShiftContent, HomeOverlayPillButton, resolveWallpaperGlassAlpha, DanmakuProto.parseFailed, failedSegmentCount, invalidateDanmakuSegment, AppBottomSheetMotion.reducedMotion, ForegroundSettleBudget. Add tools/tests/test_symbol_closure.py.
coordination: Root (owns validation tooling and the source-cohort validators)
slices.notes: Covers no entry directly; every later slice should extend its expected-miss list instead of waiting for a compile.

slices.title: Third-party license notices for carried upstream assets
